craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of workshop disputation — ends-first reasoning. Conditional test; bore-pots kept blunt. Rejected: (a) bore→made → killed: bore is bodily. Read aloud: RULED-ma-king WOULD-be-MAR-vel-ous … IF-mere POTT-er-HELP BORE-pots.

lines: Ruled making would be marvelous in kind —
l4.sanskrit_cite: racanā niyamena syādvicitrā jātirūpiṇī kulālasahakāritvamātrāccejjāyate ghaṭaḥ

reads_against.argmap: If from potter-helping? → Conditional: rule-wondrous making — if mere potter-help bore pots.
c1_essence: Potter necessary, nature watching, helpers insufficient, wisdom and will required, sufficiency tested (vv28-33).
Array excels by ends; Lord and un-Lord fenced off atomically; pradhāna will-less yet person-aim-ness stands (vv34-36).
